task: next observed groundwater level depth prediction
target_definition: Next observed water-table depth at the same CGWB station (positive = deeper).
training_dataset: CGWB quality-controlled groundwater levels over India (2000-2024 wells within India)
code_version_note: Trained via ai/groundwater_model.py; regenerate with py ai/train.py
split_strategy: chronological_by_year within station trajectories (train ≤2019, validation 2020-2022, test ≥2023); not a held-out geography split

test_persistence_baseline.note: Exact persistence MAE/RMSE/R² are written when ai/groundwater_model.py trains. Evaluation charts compare model R² against this persistence baseline on held-out data.

seasonal_naive.method: same calendar month in the prior year within station, when history exists

baseline_comparison.note: Prefer test metrics (≥2023) over validation for deployment claims. Do not invent persistence MAE without a retrain.

distribution_shift.note: Lower test R² vs validation indicates temporal distribution shift across wells/years; local field validation is required before operational use.

error_by_station.note: Per-station test MAE summary is written into metadata when training data is available.

limitations: Trained on historical CGWB well telemetry; local aquifer-specific conditions vary.
Weather and rainfall variables are excluded due to lack of spatial matching at well locations.
Assumes well depth and well type remain constant over time.
Split is temporal, not geographic — do not claim unseen-basin generalization.
Validation (2020-2022) is easier than test (≥2023); cite test metrics for honesty.
